projectDescription: An agent skill for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex that builds crafted, interactive isometric SVG illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems, with optional WebGL shaders and 3D motion.
keyFeatures: Agent skill for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex — invoke with /anatomy
Crafted isometric SVG figures with four-tone shading and painter's-order depth sorting
Optional WebGL shader layer for fire, water, caustics, and light effects inside the drawing
Optional 3D mode (beta) for parts that turn, hinge, slide, or break off in real-time
React/Next.js support with server/client split for static art and live motion
Geometry audit (kit/audit.mjs) proving no part passes through another, at rest or mid-animation
Headless Chrome verification scripts: screenshots, close-ups, line-end checks, and orbit audits
Zero npm dependencies — uses only Node.js built-in modules
publicApiSurface: fitProjection, iso, depthOf, towardViewer, screenRise — camera functions in iso-kit
slabOf, cylinder, extrude, ringOf, insetPlan, corners, haloOf — solid builders
onTop, lineOnTop, planOutline, ring, segment, topTicks, sideTicks, radialTicks — lines on faces
knurl, sideArc, sideSeam, coil — parts library
solidSvg, lineSvg, dotsSvg, wireSvg, faceTextSvg, figureSvg, fadedSvg, fadeLineSvg — SVG renderers
plateHtml, pageHtml — card and page builders
lathe, solidOf, bandOfProfile, bandsOf, disc, ringBand, sphereOf, saddleOf, rodOut, ribsOf, dotsOf, fillet — lathe.mjs
recorder, settle, auditOrExit, overlapsOf, orderKeys — audit.mjs
glLayer, glCamera, GLSL_ISO, smooth, burst, settle — gl.mjs
turning, TURN.mount, TURN.cover, TURN.poseUniforms, orbitOrExit — turn.mjs / turn-build.mjs / turn-audit.mjs
Solid, Line, Wire, Dots, FaceText, IsoFigure, Plate — React components (draw.tsx)
useReadout, useLoop, useEased, useInView, useStillness, follow, spring — React hooks (live.tsx)
